Found 6 items in registries @approvals-ui:

Showing items 1-6 of 6:

- approvals-core (registry:lib) - Headless core for approval policies: Zod schema (gates, quorums, conditions, SLAs), a policy lint with structural errors and best-practice warnings, a step-level diff, and deterministic edit ops for safe LLM or form-driven edits. [@approvals-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- approval-node (registry:component) - The approval gate card for React Flow: approvers with unassigned seats, quorum badge, condition pill, SLA badge, plus diff, validation, and live-status rings. [@approvals-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- terminal-node (registry:component) - Approved and rejected outcome pills for React Flow. [@approvals-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- workflow-canvas (registry:component) - Renders an ApprovalPolicy as a laid-out React Flow graph: automatic layout on real node sizes (react-flow-auto-layout), aligned step edges, diff and status overlays, click-to-select and pan-to-focus. [@approvals-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- validation-panel (registry:component) - Lists policy issues with severities: structural errors that should block activation and best-practice warnings (segregation of duties, single approver on high value, unassigned seats). Click an issue to focus the step on the canvas. [@approvals-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- nl-edit-panel (registry:component) - Edit the policy in plain English behind a human gate: a proposer (your LLM, or the bundled deterministic demo parser) returns a proposed policy plus its diff, the user reviews and applies or discards. Nothing lands without the click. [@approvals-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
